summary: Expanded the universe around high-density AI rack liquid cooling with a bias toward hidden or underfollowed public-market exposure rather than mega-cap AI leaders. Vertiv, Supermicro, Eaton, hyperscalers, and GPU vendors remain context anchors, but the candidate list focuses on component, CDU, water-management, connector, and test/certification-adjacent suppliers where exposure may be one or two steps away from the obvious AI demand driver. Strongest direct component evidence appears for nVent and Dover/CPC; Modine has stronger system-level data-center cooling evidence; Thermon is a lower-attention testing/load-bank and thermal-infrastructure hypothesis that needs customer/order verification.
